transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Your Name]. What brings you in today?

Well… it’s this kitchen, mostly. We had work done, or it was supposed to be done, and for almost two years I’ve been sure the contractor and some people on my block are working together somehow. Quietly, you know, not out in the open. They’re trying to cheat us and keep the kitchen half-wrong on purpose.

My husband keeps showing me receipts and saying there are explanations, but that doesn’t settle it. People can have receipts and still be up to something. And the neighbors, I know how they look over when I’m outside with the trash bins… anyway, that’s why I’m here. It’s been going on and I can’t just pretend I don’t see it.
Have you ever seen, heard, or sensed things that others don’t seem to notice, like voices or other sensations?

I don’t think so… I mean, not like voices talking to me or anything. Sometimes I notice things other people say they don’t notice, but that’s more like, you know, the way someone looks over at the house or how quiet they get when I come outside. My sister used to say I was always too observant, even when we were kids—she’d miss a change in the curtains and I’d see it right away.

But if you mean hearing things that aren’t there, no, I can’t say that’s happened.

Have you ever had thoughts or beliefs that something is happening that others don’t understand, even if it’s not about people being against you—like you have a special role or connection to something bigger?

Not really like a special role, no… I don’t think I’m chosen for anything, if that’s what you mean. It’s more this thing with the kitchen. For nearly two years now I’ve been sure the contractor and some people on my block have been quietly working together to cheat us, or keep it half-wrong on purpose.

And my husband keeps bringing out receipts like that proves everything, but receipts don’t mean people aren’t making excuses. My neighbor, for instance—well, it’s hard to explain, but they all seem to know more than they let on.
Have you ever had any unusual or strong beliefs that most people wouldn’t agree with, even about things not related to the kitchen or your neighbors?

I wouldn’t say there’s much else, no… I mean, people might think this sounds strong or unusual, but I’m here because for nearly two years I’ve been sure the contractor and some people on my block have been quietly working together to cheat us and keep my kitchen half-wrong on purpose.

And, you know, my husband keeps showing me receipts, like paper settles everything, but people can write things down and still be making excuses. I used to keep every receipt from the grocery store in an old coffee tin—my mother did that too, actually—but that doesn’t mean everyone’s honest. So no, not really other things. It’s this. This is the thing people don’t seem to want to understand.

Have you ever believed something strongly that others found hard to believe or didn’t agree with, even when there wasn’t any clear proof either way—something completely separate from the kitchen issue or your neighbors?

Separate from that? I don’t know… I’m trying to think. I’ve always had strong opinions, I suppose. My father used to say I could argue with a fence post if I thought it was leaning wrong, but that’s not the same thing, is it?

I don’t think there’s some other belief like that. Nothing I can point to. Sometimes people just don’t listen until it becomes a bigger mess, and then suddenly everyone acts like they knew all along. But no, if you mean something totally separate from all this, I can’t really think of anything.
